  "extractions": [

      "unit": "F001:F004",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F002",
          "F003",
          "F004"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F001:F004",
        "choice_text": "When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; or when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [
          "paragraph (b)",
          "§§ 1544.201",
          "1546.201",
          "1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005:F008",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F005"
        ],
        "scope_text": "As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "does not apply",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F006",
          "F007",
          "F008"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F005:F008",
        "choice_text": "The individual is one of the following: (1) Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.",
        "logic_quote": "F005",
        "references": [
          "Paragraph (a)",
          "§§ 1544.219",
          "1544.221",
          "1544.223",
          "1546.211",
          "subpart B of part 1562"
        ],
        "statement": "Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing law enforcement duty at the airport, an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F009:F010",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [
          "§ 1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F011:F013",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009",
          "F011"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless specified conditions are met.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "C000"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F012",
          "F013"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F011:F013",
        "choice_text": "Unless: (i) The passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; and (ii) The firearm is unloaded.",
        "logic_quote": "F011",
        "references": [
          "§ 1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, and the firearm is unloaded."
      }
    }

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111.
unit_attributes.choice_text: When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; or when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property.
unit_attributes.choice_text: The individual is one of the following: (1) Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing law enforcement duty at the airport, an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless specified conditions are met.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Unless: (i) The passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; and (ii) The firearm is unloaded.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, and the firearm is unloaded.
